name: gizza-ai/screenshot-beautify
summary: Wrap a screenshot in a padded, rounded, shadowed frame with a gradient backdrop

tool.description: Wrap a raw screenshot in a share-ready frame. Adds padding around the shot, rounded corners, an optional soft drop shadow, an optional macOS window title bar (traffic-light dots), and a solid or linear-gradient backdrop. Pads out to an aspect ratio (auto/16:9/4:3/1:1/9:16) without ever cropping. Params: padding (px, default 64); corner_radius (px, default 16, 0=square); shadow (bool, default true) + shadow_blur (px) + shadow_opacity (0-1); background=gradient|solid; bg_color/bg_color2 (#rgb/#rrggbb/#rrggbbaa) + gradient_angle (degrees); titlebar=none|light|dark. Express any named gradient preset via the two colors + angle. Returns a PNG (alpha needed for the shadow/rounded corners). Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref from a prior tool call.

aspect.description: Pad out to this aspect ratio (never crops); auto keeps the padded size (default auto).

bg_color.description: Primary backdrop color as #rgb/#rrggbb/#rrggbbaa (default #4f46e5 indigo). For a named gradient preset use two colors, e.g. Sunset #ff512f→#dd2476.

bg_color2.description: Second gradient color as #rgb/#rrggbb/#rrggbbaa (default #9333ea violet); ignored when background=solid.

corner_radius.description: Rounded-corner radius on the shot in pixels; 0 = square (default 16).

padding.description: Padding in pixels around the shot on every side (default 64).

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

shadow.description: Draw a soft drop shadow behind the shot (default true).

titlebar.description: macOS-style window title bar with traffic-light dots atop the shot (default none).

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
